history/plan.txt.text:
Untimed opportunity diagnostic, not a performance trial. Prepare from the latest qualified production and preserve its identity. Count history snapshot submissions and exact repetitions of the last snapshot for the same point within one simulated frame. Compare all four binary64 bit patterns (position and velocity), so signed zero and NaN payloads are not conflated. Reset the per-point state at each tracked frame. Retain every original record_point and record_collision call; instrumentation does not omit any data. Verify the default compile's exact track and charged work.

Rationale: invalidation asks whether any snapshot in a cell at a frame satisfies the exact collision predicate. Repeated identical snapshots cannot change that existential result. A direct per-point comparison could avoid append/query/allocation work if repetitions are common, without hashing, changing physics, or changing the order of nonduplicate snapshots. Count first; do not implement a new path for a negligible opportunity. This is separate from earlier history lookup-cache and flat-history layout trials.

Do not run builds or this diagnostic alongside timing. Target remains <7000 ns per charged physics frame with perfect required parity and a lean design.
